conversations.title: I was abused after meeting man on dating app
conversations.reply: That's absolutely horrific, and no one should ever have to go through that. It's a shame the app didn't have better safeguards in place to protect you.

conversations.title: Disability Gets Two Cents On The Philanthropic Dollar
conversations.reply: It's staggering to see how little support there is for disability rights. I'm glad there are people working to change this, and I hope we can see some real progress soon.

conversations.title: Great British Summer Savings is a brand opportunity, but accessibility will make it fly
conversations.reply: I love seeing brands prioritize accessibility - it's a game-changer for so many people. Let's hope more follow suit and make their events and spaces truly inclusive.

conversations.title: Ways to recognize Disability Pride Month and practice inclusivity
conversations.reply: I'm so glad we're talking about Disability Pride Month, it's a great opportunity to learn and grow together. Loving the idea of making every day more inclusive!

conversations.title: Diecast neighbours tell of 'constant anxiety' over venue noise
conversations.reply: I can imagine how stressful that must be, living with constant noise anxiety. Venues really need to think about the impact they're having on the people around them.

conversations.title: Las Vegas clubs to offer free admission for 21st birthday
conversations.reply: Free admission is a great start, but let's not forget about making sure the venue is accessible to everyone - that's what would really make it a great night out.

conversations.title: Top 200 Creators · Disability Advocacy & Inclusion
conversations.reply: It's amazing to see so many people using their platforms to advocate for disability rights and inclusion. Every voice counts, and I'm so grateful for the work they're doing.

conversations.title: Women with common health condition face higher risk of heart disease
conversations.reply: This is really concerning, and it highlights the need for better support and care for people with chronic health conditions. We need to do more to address these health disparities.
